The MSI x World of Warcraft: Midnight promotion was a collaborative campaign between and Blizzard, running from 20 August to 30 November 2025, in which participants vote between two proposed design themes, Void and Light, for a limited-edition graphics card tied to the upcoming expansion. The final graphics card was based on MSI's "Gaming Trio" cooler design, previously previewed at gamescom 2025. The card featured a color scheme consistent with the Midnight expansion's branding, including black, white, and blue elements. The specifications of the card were later revealed to be the GeForce RTX 5070 12G.
